intervals.label: operating
intervals.locator: NEXT status paper (arXiv:2201.10907) confirms completion; start/end years from secondary web summaries of NEXT-White run papers, not independently re-verified against a primary source
intervals.note: The NEXT status paper (arXiv:2201.10907) says in its own words that NEXT-White "has recently finished operation at the LSC" as of January 2022, supporting status 'completed'. The 2016 start / 2021 end years themselves are carried from secondary summaries of NEXT-White run papers (Run I-V, depleted-then-enriched xenon) and were not verified against a primary source; confidence is therefore uncertain. Operating interval; the terminal event is its end.
intervals.quote: The NEXT-White detector has recently finished operation at the LSC.

summary.plain: A smaller demonstration version of the NEXT detector, using high-pressure xenon gas, that ran at the Canfranc underground laboratory before the full-size NEXT-100 detector was built.
summary.technical: NEXT-White (NEW): smaller-scale (~5 kg xenon, per secondary literature not independently re-verified) prototype phase of the NEXT high-pressure xenon gas TPC programme at LSC, preceding NEXT-100.

technology.quote: a radiopure high-pressure xenon gas TPC
